gen_config_yaml: generate a YAML config file for speech-to-speech data preprocessing with specaugment policy and vocoder settings
load_units: load speech unit predictions from a pipe-delimited text file into a dictionary keyed by sample ID
process_units: process a list of speech units and optionally reduce consecutive duplicates to single entries
review_gen_config_yaml: review the gen_config_yaml function to understand how it configures feature transforms and vocoder settings
refactor_load_units: refactor the load_units function to support additional delimiters or file formats for unit data
